analysis: Non-attempt outage decomposition by observed previous association and requested association

setting.initial_association: empty for every user at epoch preceding the first saved epoch

source_scope: Six archived NPZ files only; Cox-PhysiCK5trainingseeds x30testepisodes, deterministic Greedy30testepisodes. This is a reaggregation of existing records, not a new simulation or training run.

definitions.HO_attempt: previous association nonempty AND requested association nonempty AND requested association differs from previous association
definitions.nonattempt_outage: executed association empty AND NOT HO_attempt
definitions.source_retention_request_outage: nonattempt_outage AND previous association nonempty AND request equals previous association
definitions.access_from_empty_request_outage: nonattempt_outage AND previous association empty AND request nonempty; includes initial access and reacquisition
definitions.nonempty_source_empty_request_outage: nonattempt_outage AND previous association nonempty AND request empty
definitions.empty_source_empty_request_outage: nonattempt_outage AND previous association empty AND request empty
definitions.before_first_service: No nonempty executed association in any strictly earlier saved epoch; initial association is empty
definitions.after_prior_service: At least one nonempty executed association in a strictly earlier saved epoch
definitions.denominator: All K*H user-epochs per episode, including outage. Pooled percentages sum numerators and denominators over the listed records; they are not sample SD or uncertainty estimates.

causal_limit: These are request/outcome categories. Association/proposal/rate arrays do not identify whether outage was caused by geometric visibility loss, disabled beam, SINR deterioration, admission rejection or execution/fallback mechanics. Empty request does not independently establish a recorded empty decision set. No physical-cause inference is made.
counts_include_reused_test_trajectories: The five learned-seed outcomes share30exogenous trajectories;150records are not150independent training runs. Greedy is not replicated five times.
